manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top of a toss, velocity is momentarily zero, but gravity continues to accelerate the ball at -g, matching a ball dropped from rest at that instant.
manifest.description: Two side-by-side lanes show a tossed ball and a dropped ball. Velocity and acceleration vectors are displayed next to each ball along with numeric readouts.
assumptions: No air resistance, constant gravity, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. At each pause, compare velocity and acceleration.
